# C9X Automotive Marketplace

> C9X is Nigeria's premier automotive ecosystem for buying and selling cars, participating in live auctions, and finding verified vehicles.

## Description
This is the official C9X marketplace frontend. Users can browse available cars, view detailed pricing and specifications, and contact sellers directly.

## Usage Guidelines for AI Agents
- **Marketplace**: You can browse all available vehicles at `/marketplace`.
- **Search**: The platform supports searching for vehicles by make, model, or year.
- **Authentication**: Users must create an account or sign in via Google to list vehicles, favorite listings, or chat with sellers.
- **Mobile Experience**: C9X is best experienced on our official iOS and Android apps.

## Key URLs
- [Homepage](https://c9x.thec9group.com/)
- [Marketplace](https://c9x.thec9group.com/marketplace)
- [Sell a Car](https://c9x.thec9group.com/list-vehicle)
- [About Us](https://c9x.thec9group.com/about)
- [Contact](https://c9x.thec9group.com/contact)

## Technical Details
This site is built with Next.js using Server-Side Rendering (SSR) for optimal SEO and performance. It relies on a BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) architecture to communicate securely with the C9X Laravel API.
